name: biobb_mddb MembraneChannels
title: Wrapper of the Membrane channels analysis from MDDB workflow module.
description: Find channels in transmembrane proteins and calculate their radius profile, using a sampling of frames. The system must include a membrane. Lipids are identified automatically, but non-standard lipid residue names may be forced through the forced_lipids field in the inputs file.
